title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S14 E04 — Happy Howl-o-Ween
Villalobos celebrates Halloween by throwing a costume party for dogs to help raise money for the rescue; an old friend from the TV crew comes to adopt a family member; Lizzy struggles to rescue a stray dog in the middle of the night.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S14 E01 — Raised in Rescue
Return adopters visit Villalobos to find a dog that will feel at home on their boat; Tania and Mariah head out to rescue a stray that is hiding beneath a shipping container; parolee Jammall starts to slip up, risking his future at the rescue.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S01 E01 — Steve's Legacy Continues
After months of croc-wrangling training with Steve Irwin's best friend Wes, Robert, Steve's son, takes the final step in his journey to feed Graham, a huge crocodile at the zoo's famous Crocoseum.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S01 E05 — Bindi's Lemur Island
The Australia Zoo's alligator snapping turtles need a health check, and it's Robert's job to protect from their fierce bites; Terri and Bindi welcome seven new lemurs from the United States; the Rescue Unit must save possums caught in a chimney.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S01 E02 — Tiger Eyes
Hunter the Sumatran tiger is blind and must be sedated for his annual eye check; the keepers prepare young giraffe Scarlett for a road trip to South Australia, reuniting her with family.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S01 E03 — Giraffe Road Trip
The family prepares Croc One, Steve Irwin's research ship, for a mission to release an endangered sea turtle back to the wild; Scarlett the giraffe reunites with her grandmother; Grub the wild echidna is released from the Zoo's Wildlife Hospital.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S01 E04 — Robert, King of Cobras
Robert wrangles Utah, a venomous 12-foot king cobra; Dr. Amber visits Pandora to care for wild koalas; back at the zoo, an old injury flares up for Bruce the brolga, a bird that has been in the Irwins' care for 26 years.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:
S04 E01 — A Mild Winter
The family faces the fallout from a warm Alaskan winter; an emergency mission to supply and secure hunting cabins; Charlotte and Jane search for a missing newborn calf.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:
S04 E02 — Moving Toward the Future
The family struggles to move a two-ton bridge to allow for crucial access to the head of the bay; Otto and Charlotte fight a threat to their cattle.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:
S04 E03 — Spring Forward
The family bands together to protect its livelihood; Atz Lee and Jane encounter disaster while bear hunting; Atz Sr., Bonnie and Shane defend against grizzlies.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:
S04 E04 — On the Move
Life returns to the homestead in the spring; tensions are high on the annual Kilcher cattle drive; Otto tries to maintain control of his crew.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:
S04 E05 — Loaded for Bear
Atz Lee and Jane hunt for black bear but end up facing a grizzly; Otto and Eivin try to introduce new bulls into the family herd.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:
S04 E06 — Greener Pastures
The Kilchers have four months to finish a year's worth of work; Atz Lee and Jane chase a salmon run; Otto and Eivin bolster the homestead's defenses to contain the herd.

description:
S02 E02 — Cats: Cute-A-Polooza
Naughty felines are caught in the act; cute kittens attempt to mimic the actions of their human friends.

title: America's Cutest
description:
S02 E03 — Cats: Extreme Fluff
"Ninja Cats" employ stealthy moves; other categories include "Techno Tabbies," "Feline Foodies" and "Cats With Catitude."

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E06 — Storm Surge
The search is on for a missing boater who may have suffered a stroke on Corney Lake; wildlife agents deploy as a hurricane makes landfall, rescuing stranded survivors from the floodwaters and dispensing lifesaving supplies.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E05 — Felon Hunter
Wildlife agents interrogate a felon caught hunting with a firearm; witnesses report a hunter trying to bludgeon a swimming deer from his boat; a duck shot out of season leads agents to a slew of violations.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E04 — Fowl Play
LDWF biologists undertake an explosive mission to help conserve Louisiana's wild turkeys; a suspicious deer skull points to a hunter flouting the law; more than 1,000 lbs of shrimp are at stake when a captain is caught in a major violation.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E03 — Gator Voodoo
When wildlife agents find an alligator with a fresh bullet wound to the head, nearby anglers are the prime suspects; an injured hunter must be evacuated by helicopter; agents use drones to track crabbers selling their catch across state lines.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E01 — Hunting the Hunter
When an elderly man goes missing in a vast wilderness area, wildlife agents race to find him before nightfall; a tip leads agents to a haul of undersized redfish and anglers who refuse to confess; bloody evidence ties a trespasser to an illegal deer.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E02 — Fugitive on the Bayou
Wildlife agents join a manhunt for an armed fugitive on the bayou; a nervous young hunter reveals a serious violation; a night shrimping bust leads to a familiar and unrepentant culprit.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E07 — Blood Don't Lie
Wildlife agents question a hunter with something to hide; a group of youths shooting ducks from a moving boat is caught in the act; frightened hunters accuse a landowner of serial harassment.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S13 E06 — Last Days of Winter
The dive team assists at an event in Hampton Beach; Officer Courtney patrols the area's clam flats; Officers Hannett and Holmes patrol snowmobile activity across the state; Officer Demler helps a bobcat that's been injured by a porcupine.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S13 E05 — In the Thick of It
A busy day at the state's largest ice fishing derby; Officer Canfield searches for the owner of a frozen fishing line; Major Juneau leads a mountain rescue; Officer McKee clocks the speed of snowmobiles; Officer Cyrs checks on a stuck moose.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S13 E01 — Wild Winter
Officer Bronson questions a hunter who shot a deer without having the proper permit; while Officer Demler runs radar on a popular snowmobile trail, Sgt. Lucas investigates a suspicious deer kill site; Officer Cyrs responds to a snowmobile accident.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S06 E09 — Can't Believe Your Eyes
Wardens perform double duty in summer; Warden Judd comes to the rescue of a baby skunk; McCabe and Robertson investigate a missing, stolen ATV.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S06 E10 — The Rescuers
At Camp North Woods, Herring, Parker and Lounder mentor aspiring kid wardens; injured hiker on the Appalachian Trail calls for emergency evacuation before nightfall; hurt porcupine; McKenney searches for a teenage runaway.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S06 E08 — Close Encounters of the Wild Kind
Wardens spring into action when Maine's wildlife wanders into human territory; Marquis and Fitzpatrick try to catch a dumpster-diving bear; Warden Lounder chases a wily woodchuck.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S13 E04 — Snow Way Out
Officers Bronson and Towne get more than they bargained for with a speeding snowmobiler; the K-9 unit performs winter training; Officer MacFadzen patrols an ice drag racing event; Officer Cyrs heads into the woods to investigate a hit-and-run.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S13 E02 — Frozen Over
Officer Hannett patrols for ice fishermen while Lt. Boudreau investigates a hunter who shot towards a road; Officer Holmes deals with a raccoon hiding in a warm chimney; Officer St. Pierre goes on his first dive recovery under the ice.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S13 E03 — Treacherous Trails
During a busy winter weekend, Lt. Boudreau encounters kite skiers, an illegal fire sled and a vandalized bob-house; Officer Canfield searches for a deer with an arrow in its head; Officers Demler and Towne head out on a treacherous mountain rescue.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S06 E01 — Shy Kitties: Pint Sized
In a cozy home of Himalayans, a shy kitten named Hugo follows in his father's footsteps; a rags-to-riches rescue mix brings her brood of puppies to their new dream home and only girl, Honey, makes an unlikely friend.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S06 E03 — Super Pups: Pint Sized
Twin dachshund pups, Lulu and Betty, discover their different personalities with a little bit of guidance from their free spirit father; a show pup in training, Chinese Crested Dotty, forms an unlikely friendship with rescue pit bull Bryan.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S06 E02 — Rescue Kittens & Water Babies: Pint Sized
A cat-loving rescue dog named Sweet Potato welcomes a pair of rescue kittens into their new foster home.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S06 E04 — Graceful Giants: Pint Sized
Chip, a golden retriever puppy, tries to be the center of attention; a Great Dane's long legs make the dog a tad clumsy.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E05 — Hope for Hoppy
Dr. Ross performs surgery on a second-chance pup; Dr. Lavigne checks up on a prickly pet; Dr. Blue treats an injured owl, then joins Dr. Ross in checking on a cute litter of sick, tiny piglets.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E06 — Training Day
Dr. Lavigne attacks an older dog's tumors; Dr. Ross tries to save a rabbit's foot mauled by a dog; Dr. Blue takes on a mission to castrate a violent donkey.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E08 — Lights, Camera, Action!
A mother dog with two puppies stuck in her uterus needs an emergency C-section; Dr. Ross and Dr. Lavigne address eye issues; vets make a video for the clinic.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E04 — Raining Cats, Dogs, and Tigers
The clinic takes in displaced animals during the massive flooding in Houston; Dr. Blue helps a puppy with a deadly disease acquired from standing water; Dr. Lavigne and Dr. Ross examine a wandering tiger.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E06 — Graveyard of Peed on Things
A woman's cat Pip is a one-eyed feline with cerebellar hypoplasia who torments her other cat, Red; a little girl's birthday present named Autumn is destructive to their home and targets the couch, beds, computer monitor and microwave.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E05 — Macho Cat
A couple who has moved in together have merged the lives of their two cats. Since the move, Buddy has become territorial and a bully; two roommates adopted a cat who destroys and pees on everything in their apartment.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E04 — Feral Scottish Fold
Buddy's owners are determined to transform him into the perfect indoor cat, despite his aggressive tendencies; Kali was recently adopted but due to her terrorizing behavior she may end up back in the shelter.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E10 — Trying to Deal with the Devil
Deep in Mexico's Baja desert lies the scorching wasteland of the Devil's Canyon; a Canadian mountain man teams up with an experienced homesteader to take on the canyon's triple-digit heat, scarce water, and venomous predators.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
21 Miles, 21 Days
In a lethal African hunting ground, a biker chick and a taxidermist have to stay on the move to survive; the pair must push across 21 miles of savanna to find food and water while avoiding a pride of lions that's tracking them every step of the way.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E09 — Blood, Sweat and Fears
Two survivalists are back for redemption in the Mexican jungle but torrential downpours, competing survival styles and a machete accident threaten to send them home early again.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E06 — Close Encounters
Two strangers are dropped in one of the most dangerous African locations in the dead heat of summer; faced with aggressive hippos and charging elephants, they quickly learn their place but must mark their territory if they want to make it 21 days.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E08 — Clash of the Survivalists
Forced to trek two days to a water source, a laid-back hunter and an opinionated adventurer clash in Zambia, risking their 21-day challenge; as danger mounts, their trust cracks.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E06 — Everglades Thirst Trap
Two survivalists fight to endure 21 days of extreme dehydration in the drought-stricken Everglades. With no potable water available, the pair is threatened with an early tap-out.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E01 — Flesh and Fangs
Legend Matt Wright crashes into two survivalists in Florida's Everglades, where intense heat, severe storms and aggressive crocs threaten to take everyone out of the challenge.

S01 E03 — Puppies and Ducklings
Follow puppies in the first months of these Pugs, Mini-Australian Shepherds and Rottweilers' lives as they will be adventure-filled, including a lesson in duck-herding.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S01 E05 — Kitten Dolls
Heartwarming romps featuring hairless Sphynxes, inquisitive Burmese cats, and tiny Ragdolls who buddy up to German Shepherds.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E08 — One Wrong Step
While vacationing in South Africa, Peter Knottenbelt suddenly finds himself in the jaws of a massive crocodile; in Nova Scotia, Meg Doyle is walking her beloved dog when they're suddenly ambushed by a pair of angry raccoons.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E07 — All Alone
During an archery hunt in Cranbrook, British Columbia, Chad Dueck comes face-to-face with a mother grizzly bear; in Tracy, Calif., Walt Dean King is savagely attacked by a Brahma Bull roaming his neighborhood.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E06 — Safari Horror
Bob Legasa is hunting in Montana and what he thinks is a bluff charge from a grizzly bear is, in fact, a near-lethal attack; while canoeing in Zimbabwe, Kristen Yaldor is thrown into the water and finds herself in the jaws of a hippopotamus.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S02 E01 — A Python Ate My Pet
The Venom One team encounters a python with a possible family pet in its stomach.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S02 E04 — Flesh-Eating Lizards
Floridians face threats from carnivorous African Nile monitor lizards, red-tailed boa constrictors and poisonous Eastern diamondbacks.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S02 E03 — Killer Bees Attack
The Venom One team stages a rescue when deadly bees threaten an elderly living facility.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S02 E02 — Hurricane: Gator Lockdown
The Venom One team races to contain a 400-pound alligator, angry crocodiles and poisonous snakes.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E06 — Africa's Deadliest
Jeremy Wade returns to the Okavango Delta to re-investigate a predatory carnivore that may have mauled over 100 victims of a capsized boat; to discover the truth, Jeremy offers himself up as live bait.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E02 — Mekong Mutilator
Jeremy Wade is lured to the shores of the Mekong River in Cambodia to search for a monstrous fish that has mauled, blinded, killed and most recently sliced clean through a young man's testicle.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E03 — Coral Reef Killer
On the tropical island of Sulawesi, Indonesia, a tourist snorkeler and several local fishermen have been killed and injured by a mysterious sea creature that impales its victims; Wade travels to the scene to investigate.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E02 — Ice Cold Killer
Traveling from London to Greenland and on to Norway, Wade follows the trail of an unknown sea monster; fishing through ice to extreme depths, he attempts to reel in this monster before the full fury of an Arctic storm hits.

title: River Monsters
description:
Killers From the Abyss
Wade takes on the biggest investigation of his career -- to unravel what happened to over 1,000 passengers of the RMS Laconia, torpedoed in the mid-Atlantic; he travels the globe, battling giant fish, massive sharks and a deep-sea monster.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E04 — Return of the Killer Catfish
Jeremy Wade investigates a case in Nepal that sounds strangely familiar -- a lone fisherman dragged off his feet and into a mountain river by the original river monster, the goonch catfish.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E06 — Malaysian Lake Monster
After two men vanish from a remote lake in Malaysia, Jeremy sets out to find the possible culprit; a trail of evidence leads Jeremy into an ancient rainforest, where an old adversary lies in wait.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E05 — Volcanic Island Terror
On a volcanic island in the Pacific, terror grips a fishing community when something in the water leaves a trail of bloody victims in its wake; the only clues they have to the attacker's identity are the large puncture wounds it left behind.
